Spain Wins FIFA World Cup in Extra Time Against Argentina

Spain has won the FIFA World Cup, defeating Argentina 1-0 in extra time. Ferran Torres scored the decisive goal, securing Spain's second World Cup title. The match saw Argentina play with ten men after a red card, and Lionel Messi's final World Cup appearance ended without a trophy. The victory marks a significant achievement for Spain, with young player Lamine Yamal also making history.
